subject: craft
angle: Where the QR code belongs on a card, and how small is too small
caption:
The QR code looks sharp on screen, but print it too small on textured paper and cameras give up.

· Place it on the back card or insert
· Keep the code at two centimeters minimum
· High contrast ink helps phone cameras scan fast
· Test prints prevent scanning issues later
